```{r}

#chemical list with categories assigned (generated in 02_apply_chemical_classifications)
t1<- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path2, "CTD_all_analytic_categories_1364_10.28.25.xlsx")) 

##=====: generate table 1
# Summarize data by Category, getting desired descriptives
summary_data <- t1 %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    min1 = min(total_count),
    Quartile1 = quantile(total_count, probs = 0.25),
    Median_Value2 = median(total_count),
    Quartile3 = quantile(total_count, probs = 0.75),
    max1 = max(total_count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


write.xlsx(summary_data, paste0(source_path, "CTD_table1_11.11.25.xlsx"))
```

## chemical and disease gene lists

```{r}
#1. Create supplemental table 1: list of all chemicals and gene symbols

#try pivot wider

  group_by(chemical_name) %>%

#save
write.xlsx(test.chem , paste0(source_path3, "CTD_supplemental_table1_11.5.25.xlsx"))

adis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_AD_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>%

agora.ad <- read.csv(paste0(a_path, "gene_list_ANGORA_june92026.csv")) %>%

agora.ad <- agora.ad %>%
  arrange(agora.ad)
  
edis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_ERstress_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(ER.stress = Gene.symbol)
  
idis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_ISR_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(Integrated.stress.response = Gene.symbol)


mdis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_microglial_cell_activation_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(microglial.cell.activation = Gene.symbol)


pdis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_proteostatsisDeficencies_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(proteostatsis.deficencies = Gene.symbol)


rdis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_RUP_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(Response.to.unfolded.protein = Gene.symbol)


tdis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_tau_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(Tauopathies = Gene.symbol)


tddis <- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path4, "CTD_TDPProteinopathies_8.6.25.xlsx")) %>% 
  select(Gene.symbol) %>%
  rename(TDP.proteinopathies = Gene.symbol)

#cbind above
all.dis <- cbindX(agora.ad, adis, edis, idis, mdis, pdis, rdis, tdis, tddis)

#save
write.xlsx(all.dis, paste0(source_path, "CTD_supplemental_table2_6.10.26.xlsx"))
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

# Figure 2

## volcano plots per disease list: colored by significance PRR is a fold change calculated as a ratio of two proportions- one represents frequency of adverse event for the drug of interest and the other represents the frequency of the same event for other drugs or a comparison group PRR 2 - indicates specific adverse event is reported twice as frequently for the drug of interest compared to the comparison group representing 2 fold increase PRR 0.5- indicates event is reported half as frequently for the drug of interest representing a 2-fold decrease with log2 transformation: PRR of 1 (null) becomes 0; PRR of 2 (twice the reporting) becomes 1 PRR of 0.5 (half the reporting) becomes -1

```{r}
#calculate log2 (PRR) and -log10(p-value)
ad$log2prr <- log2(ad$prr)
ad$log10p <- -log10(ad$fisher_FDR)

agora$log2prr <- log2(agora$prr)
agora$log10p <- -log10(agora$fisher_FDR)

er$log2prr <- log2(er$prr)
er$log10p <- -log10(er$fisher_FDR)

isr$log2prr <- log2(isr$prr)
isr$log10p <- -log10(isr$fisher_FDR)

mgca$log2prr <- log2(mgca$prr)
mgca$log10p <- -log10(mgca$fisher_FDR)

prod$log2prr <-log2(prod$prr)
prod$log10p <- -log10(prod$fisher_FDR)

rup$log2prr <-log2(rup$prr)
rup$log10p <- -log10(rup$fisher_FDR) 

tau$log2prr <- log2(tau$prr) 
tau$log10p <- -log10(tau$fisher_FDR)

tdpp$log2prr<- log2(tdpp$prr)
tdpp$log10p <- -log10(tdpp$fisher_FDR)
```

```{r}
#set thresholds
p.threshold <- 0.05
prr.threshold <- 2

#plot using transformed

ad. <- ggplot(ad, aes(x = log2prr, y = log10p)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(log10p > -log10(p.threshold) & abs(log2prr) > log2(prr.threshold),
                                ifelse(log2prr > 0, "Enriched", "Depleted"),
                                "No enrichment or depletion")), # Color points based on significance and change
             alpha = 0.5) + # Add transparency
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-log2(prr.threshold), log2(prr.threshold)), # Vertical lines for fold change thresholds
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p.threshold), # Horizontal line for p-value threshold
             linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Enriched" = "red", "Depleted" = "blue", "No enrichment or depletion" = "gray")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-6.522, 6.7940)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 263.860)) +
  labs(x = "Log2 (Proportional Reporting Ratio): Measure of overlap between chemical genes and pathway genes",
       y = "-Log10 (P-value)",
       title = "Alzheimer's disease") +
  theme_minimal() + # Use a minimal theme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), # Removes x-axis title
        axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "none", 
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        plot.title.position = "plot")
```

```{r}
library(UpSetR)

#setwd only used for this chunk for ease of reading formatting and plotting 
# R enviornment cleared and reloaded after 
setwd("G:/My Drive/Bakulski Lab/Projects/CTD-Dementia/data/8.6.25 download/")

#Read Result data in as a list 
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#1: vector with files names
my_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.xlsx$")


#2: Create list 
my_data <- lapply(my_files, read.xlsx)
#1: get names in better format 
names(my_data) <- stringr::str_replace(my_files, pattern = ".xlsx", replacement = "")

#-------
listinput <- list(Alzheimers.disease = my_data[["CTD_AD_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]], 
                  Response.ER.stress = my_data[["CTD_ERstress_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]], 
                  Integrated.stress.response = my_data[["CTD_ISR_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]],
                  Microglial.cell.activation = my_data[["CTD_microglial_cell_activation_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]], 
                  Proteostasis.deficiencies = my_data[["CTD_proteostatsisDeficencies_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]], 
                  Agora.AD = my_data[["gene_list_ANGORA_june92026"]][["Gene.Symbol"]], 
                  Response.unfolded.protein = my_data[["CTD_RUP_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]], 
                  Tauopathies = my_data[["CTD_tau_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]], 
                  TDPproteinopathies = my_data[["CTD_TDPProteinopathies_8.6.25"]][["Gene.symbol"]])
```

## Prep for table 2 and supplemental table 3

```{r}
cat<-readRDS(paste0(source_path2, "chem_with_cats_1008_11.10.25.rds"))

agora.ad<- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "agora_6.10.26.xlsx")) %>% 
select(chemical_name, prr, prr_LCI, prr_UCI, fisher_FDR) %>%
mutate(disease = "Agora.Alzheimer's disease") %>%
 mutate(enriched = ifelse(prr >= 2, 1, 0)) %>%
 left_join(cat, by = "chemical_name")

ad<- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "ad_11.5.25.xlsx")) %>% 
select(chemical_name, prr, prr_LCI, prr_UCI, fisher_FDR) %>%
mutate(disease = "Alzheimer's disease") %>%
 mutate(enriched = ifelse(prr >= 2, 1, 0)) %>%
 left_join(cat, by = "chemical_name")

er<- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "er_11.5.25.xlsx")) %>% 
select(chemical_name, prr, prr_LCI, prr_UCI,fisher_FDR) %>%
mutate(disease = "ER stress") %>%
 mutate(enriched = ifelse(prr >= 2, 1, 0)) %>%
 left_join(cat, by = "chemical_name")

isr<- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "isr_11.5.25.xlsx")) %>% 
select(chemical_name, prr, prr_LCI, prr_UCI, fisher_FDR) %>%
mutate(disease = "Integrated stress response") %>%
 mutate(enriched = ifelse(prr >= 2, 1, 0)) %>%
 left_join(cat, by = "chemical_name")

mgca<- read.xlsx(paste0(source_path, "mgca_11.5.25.xlsx")) %>% 
select(chemical_name, prr, prr_LCI, prr_UCI, fisher_FDR) %>%
```

```{r}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate rank within each group and then sum the ranks
top_hits_table <- all.dis %>%
  group_by(disease) %>%
  mutate(Rank = rank(fisher_FDR)) %>% # Rank by value (smaller value = better rank)
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(chemical_name) %>%
  summarise(Summed_Rank = sum(Rank), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(Summed_Rank) %>%
  head(n = 10) # Display top 20 items based on summed rank


#dataset input: "all.dis" generated line 485 prep for table 2 -->
#then ranked hits --> then top hits
#then subset ranked hits by names in top hits 
top10.names <- top_hits_table$chemical_name
top10.names <- c("bisphenol A",
                  "sodium arsenite",
                  "Benzo(a)pyrene",
                  "Valproic Acid",
                  "Tretinoin",
                  "Arsenic Trioxide",
                  "Acetylcysteine",
                  "Cadmium Chloride",
                  "Particulate Matter",
                  "Tobacco Smoke Pollution")


top10<- ranked_hits_table[ranked_hits_table$chemical_name %in% top10.names, ]

#PRR forest plot
# to maintain order throughout the plot 
top10$chem_ID <- paste0(top10$chemical_name, "_" ,top10$disease)


#transform 
top10$log2prr <- log2(top10$prr)
top10$log2prr_LCI <- log2(top10$prr_LCI)
top10$log2prr_UCI <- log2(top10$prr_UCI)
top10$log10p <- -log10(top10$fisher_FDR)


#Forest Plots

library(ggsci)

#plot  
fp.prr <- ggplot(data=top10, aes(x=chem_ID, y=log2prr, ymin=log2prr_LCI, ymax=log2prr_UCI, color = disease)) +
  geom_pointrange()+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, lty=1, size =1) +  
  geom_hline(yintercept=-1, lty=2, color = "blue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=1, lty=2, color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=log2prr_LCI, ymax=log2prr_UCI), width=0.5, cex=0.5)+ 
  coord_flip() + 
  geom_point(shape = 15, size = 2) +
  xlab("Chemical") +
  ylab("Log2 (Proportional Reporting Ratio): Measure of overlap between chemical genes and pathway genes") + 
  scale_color_ucscgb()

fp.prr
```
